run_ml_inference_cli: run the ml_inference CLI to predict HER voltage from computational and experimental CSV data
run_volcano_plot: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot of PC1 vs predicted voltage
run_parity_plot: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot of experimental vs predicted voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get a DataFrame of aggregate mean energies per bulk ID from a computational CSV or parquet file
run_inference_with_features: run the ml_inference CLI with add_features to include matminer elemental features in the linear regression model
